measurements.name: Gulf Stream
measurements.width_metric_label: 1967 transport-float sections: mean and sampled span
measurements.range_interpretation: Author mean135 km from three complete crossings with widths145,140,120 km. Finite campaign span120–145 km; no fourth independent mean occupation, width error, confidence interval, seasonal or annual extrema.
measurements.geographic_scope: Cape Hatteras offshore fixed TR-038 baseline; three non-synoptic crossings in1967. Not the whole Gulf Stream or Gulf Stream System.
measurements.section_orientation: Width along a baseline bearing135 degrees true; transport velocity is the component normal to that baseline. Recorded flow directions vary; no exact flow-normal projection applied.
measurements.layer: Transport per unit width integrated from surface to local bottom, with variable bathymetry. No fixed-depth width layer or surface-only speed boundary.
measurements.time_convention: Three complete crossings1,3,4:30June–5July,11–15July,16–18July1967. Campaign26June–18July is separate. Multi-day occupations, not simultaneous snapshots or continuous monthly/seasonal means; source clock timezone unspecified.
measurements.boundary_rule: Authors smooth transport-per-unit-width measurements and extend their curves to zero. No negative inshore transport was observed; inshore edges are extrapolated. Two complete crossings have offshore negative values, one offshore edge is also extended to zero.
measurements.source_citation: Richardson, P. L. and Knauss, J. A. (1971), Gulf Stream and Western Boundary Undercurrent observations at Cape Hatteras, Deep-Sea Research18,1089–1109, doi:10.1016/0011-7471(71)90095-7.
measurements.source_locator: Methods printed1091/PDF3; Fig2 printed1093/PDF5; zero-edge construction printed1094–1095/PDF6–7; Table2 printed1105/PDF17; mean135 km printed1107/PDF19.
measurements.extraction_method: Transcribed explicit author widths and mean; matched complete occupations using Figure2 and Table2. No curve digitization, geographic endpoints or width error inferred.
measurements.source_quality_note: Inshore zero boundaries are author extrapolations, not observed sign reversals. Multi-day sampling and changing flow direction limit synoptic/flow-normal interpretation. Baseline135 degrees differs from mean135 km.

existing_current_records.name: Gulf Stream
existing_current_records.range_interpretation: Publisher Table 2 distance rounded to kilometres. Width uncertainty is not reported. Transport uncertainty is a separate quantity. Separate cruises and layers are not an annual range.
existing_current_records.geographic_scope: Gulf Stream 36∘ N; source longitude limits -71.7:-69.1 degrees east. Section track may deviate from nominal latitude near boundaries. Endpoint latitudes remain unextracted.
existing_current_records.section_orientation: Nominally zonal hydrographic track; boundary/platform stations may deviate to cross the main flow. Exact boundary track orientation unresolved.
existing_current_records.layer: Publisher neutral-density layer indices 1:6; reported depth extent 0 to 891 m. Density surfaces are not a uniform fixed-depth slice.
existing_current_records.time_convention: 74AB20050501: section sampled 2005-05-03 to 2005-06-12; inverse-model group 2000–2009. Cruise snapshot, not a decade mean or seasonal composite.
existing_current_records.boundary_rule: Section 2.3: station pairs selected by consistent slope of eastward accumulated horizontal mass transport; vertical extent by the same integrated flow direction. No fixed speed cutoff or instantaneous velocity envelope inferred.
existing_current_records.source_citation: Caínzos et al. (2023), Consistent picture of the horizontal circulation of the Atlantic Ocean over 3 decades, Ocean Science 19, 1009–1045, doi:10.5194/os-19-1009-2023.
existing_current_records.source_locator: Table 2, Worksheet 1, row 59, columns A–F; Table 1 row 13; Sections 2.1–2.3.
existing_current_records.extraction_method: Publisher XLSX cells retained and distance transcribed directly; explicit section/cruise join. No map or longitude-to-distance conversion.
